PREPLANNING_CONTEXT: {"version":1,"schema_version":2,"epicId":"7315-5768-34fc-4060","generatedAt":"2026-06-02T00:00:00Z","generatedBy":"preplanning","epic":{"title":"Cross-skill signal contracts foundation + decomposer enforcement + preplanning fan-in gate","description":"Contracts-dir convention + Design C decomposer critic + preplanning fan-in gate + heuristic post-pass + regression fixtures.","successCriteria":["sc-1","sc-2","sc-3","sc-4","sc-5"]},"researchFindings":[],"stories":[{"id":"ccf3-a4ad-afc8-4974","title":"As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want a versioned cross-skill contract directory with a schema validator and a build-failing hook, so that every signal contract doc is machine-checkable before it lands.","description":"## Description
**What**: Establish the plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ directory convention with the contract schema {canonical_name, canonical_surface, semantic, producer, consumers, smoke_test}, a schema validator, the reference contract doc copy-story.md, its sibling test plugins/dso/tests/contract-copy-story.sh, and a pre-commit/CI hook that fails the build on any non-conforming contract doc.
**Why**: This is the walking skeleton every other story anchors against. The decomposer critic (draft-3) reads canonical_surface from these docs; future Epic B verifier work consumes the sibling tests. Without a machine-checkable contract record, the typo-coherence anchor has nothing to compare against.
**Scope**:
- IN: contracts directory convention; the six-field schema; a schema validator that parses each contracts/*.md and reports conformance; copy-story.md as the reference instance; the sibling contract-copy-story.sh smoke test runnable via test-batched.sh; a pre-commit/CI hook wired to fail the build on non-conforming docs.
- OUT: backfilling contract docs for already-closed epics; structured JSON payload validation (already enforced); Epic B verifier consumption of sibling tests.","priority":0,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":true,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["The directory plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ exists and contains copy-story.md populated with all six schema fields canonical_name, canonical_surface, semantic, producer, consumers, smoke_test ← Satisfies: sc-1","A schema validator parses plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-story.md and exits zero, and exits non-zero on a doc missing any of the six fields ← Satisfies: sc-1","The sibling test plugins/dso/tests/contract-copy-story.sh runs green via test-batched.sh ← Satisfies: sc-1","A pre-commit/CI hook runs the schema validator over every plugins/dso/docs/contracts/*.md and fails the build when any doc is non-conforming ← Satisfies: sc-1","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including the validator's pass case and its missing-field failure case ← Satisfies: sc-1"],"considerations":["[Walking-skeleton] Every downstream story anchors against the canonical_surface field; keep the schema field names verbatim to the epic so draft-3's coherence anchor matches.","[Self-reference] This epic modifies the plugin that plans it; the validator and hook must not break the existing pre-commit gate suite.","[Testing] Use test-batched.sh with --runner=bash for the sibling contract test per project convention."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":[],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-1"},{"id":"00dc-daf2-6b74-4c44","title":"As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want the story-decomposer to declare per-story emits_signals and consumes_signals inline plus a post-draft signal_manifest, so that cross-skill signal couplings are captured structurally at draft time.","description":"## Description
**What**: Add Design C hybrid inline signal declaration to dso:story-decomposer: per-story emits_signals and consumes_signals fields carrying {canonical_name, surface, semantic} (plus detection on the consumer side), and a post-draft signal_manifest reflection block that aggregates every declared signal across the drafted story set.
**Why**: The deterministic critic (draft-3) and the preplanning fan-in gate (draft-4) both consume these structured fields; the original f360 failure mode was unstructured signal coupling that no gate could read. This story produces the structured substrate.
**Scope**:
- IN: emits_signals/consumes_signals field schema in the decomposer agent contract; the detection sub-field on consumer declarations; the post-draft signal_manifest reflection block aggregating declared signals; documentation of the new fields in the agent spec.
- OUT: the critic's three checks (draft-3); the heuristic post-pass (draft-5); the preplanning fan-in gate (draft-4); sprint/implementation-plan changes beyond reading signal_manifest.","priority":1,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["A drafted story carries an emits_signals field whose entries each contain canonical_name, surface, and semantic ← Satisfies: sc-2","A drafted consumer story carries a consumes_signals field whose entries each contain canonical_name, surface, semantic, and detection ← Satisfies: sc-2","The decomposer emits a post-draft signal_manifest reflection block aggregating every emits_signals and consumes_signals declaration across the drafted story set ← Satisfies: sc-2","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including a fixture asserting the signal_manifest aggregates a producer and a consumer declaration ← Satisfies: sc-2"],"considerations":["[Schema-coherence] The surface and detection sub-fields are the values draft-3 anchors against canonical_surface in the contract doc; keep the field names stable.","[Self-reference] These fields live in the dso:story-decomposer agent the orchestrator dispatches; changes must remain backward-compatible with decomposer outputs that predate the field."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["ccf3-a4ad-afc8-4974"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-2"},{"id":"9c77-f8ff-7b8d-409a","title":"As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want a deterministic decomposer critic enforcing three signal-coherence checks that refuses to emit on the f360-3a5b fixture, so that producer/consumer surface mismatches are blocked at decomposition time.","description":"## Description
**What**: Add a deterministic critic script to dso:story-decomposer that enforces three checks against the structured signals from draft-2: (a) each declared producer surface appears in the named producer story body and each consumer detection appears in the named consumer story body; (b) for every canonical_name with a corresponding plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<canonical_name>.md, the producer-side surface and consumer-side detection both match the contract doc's canonical_surface field; (c) cross-story edges are derived by matching consumes_signals.canonical_name against emits_signals.canonical_name. Each check emits a machine-distinguishable gate identifier on failure ("drift" for check (a), "canonical-anchor" for check (b), and the sc-4 post-pass emits "heuristic-undeclared-signal") rather than a single opaque critic-error, so downstream regression tests can assert which gate fired. On the f360-3a5b pre-fix fixture the critic emits the drift gate identifier and refuses to emit until surfaces are reconciled.
**Why**: This is the producer/consumer signaling-core enforcement that closes the original false-positive gap.
**Scope**:
- IN: the deterministic critic script; the three checks (a)/(b)/(c); a machine-distinguishable gate identifier per check (drift, canonical-anchor); the canonical_surface anchor against contract docs; cross-story edge derivation by canonical_name match; refuse-to-emit behavior keyed to the firing gate identifier; the f360-3a5b pre-fix fixture used to prove refusal.
- OUT: the heuristic zero-declaration post-pass (draft-5, which emits the heuristic-undeclared-signal identifier); the inline field schema (draft-2); preplanning fan-in (draft-4).","priority":1,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["Check (a) emits a critic failure tagged with the gate identifier "drift" when a declared producer surface is absent from the named producer story body or a consumer detection is absent from the named consumer story body ← Satisfies: sc-2","Check (b) emits a critic failure tagged with the gate identifier "canonical-anchor" when a producer surface or consumer detection diverges from the canonical_surface field of the matching plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<canonical_name>.md ← Satisfies: sc-2","Check (c) derives a cross-story edge by matching a consumes_signals.canonical_name to an emits_signals.canonical_name across the drafted stories ← Satisfies: sc-2","Each of the three gates emits a distinct machine-readable gate identifier (drift, canonical-anchor, and the sc-4 post-pass heuristic-undeclared-signal) so a consumer can tell which gate fired without parsing prose ← Satisfies: sc-2","Fed the f360-3a5b pre-fix fixture, the critic emits the drift gate identifier and the decomposer refuses to emit until the surfaces are reconciled ← Satisfies: sc-2","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including one test per check, one asserting the three gate identifiers are pairwise distinct, and the f360 refusal case ← Satisfies: sc-2"],"considerations":["[Determinism] The critic is a deterministic script, not an LLM judgment; the original failure mode was prompt-directive enforcement that drifted.","[Self-reference] The f360-3a5b pre-fix fixture must encode the producer copy-story / consumer copy:needed mismatch that the real f360 epic shipped with.","[Coupling] Check (b) reads canonical_surface from draft-1's contract docs; if no contract doc exists for a canonical_name, check (b) is skipped for that name and only checks (a)/(c) apply.","[Gate-identifiers] Each check emits a stable machine-distinguishable gate identifier (drift, canonical-anchor; the sc-4 post-pass emits heuristic-undeclared-signal) instead of a single opaque critic-error, so draft-6's distinct-gate regression assertion is mechanically verifiable. Treat these identifier strings as a contract draft-6 depends on; do not rename without updating the regression fixtures."],"scopeSplitCandidate":true,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["ccf3-a4ad-afc8-4974","00dc-daf2-6b74-4c44"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-2"},{"id":"5369-e1d4-4feb-4329","title":"As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want /dso:preplanning to require an integration story whenever the union of depends_on and cross_story_signals graphs shows fan-in or any signal edge, so that every cross-story coupling gets integration coverage.","description":"## Description
**What**: Add a fan-in detector to /dso:preplanning computed against the union of the depends_on graph and the cross_story_signals graph (the edges draft-3's critic derives). It requires an integration story when (a) any node has fan-in >= 2 in either graph, OR (b) any cross_story_signals edge exists at all. The required integration story's Done Definition references an orchestrator-entry fixture exercising producer -> consumer -> artifact through /dso:brainstorm or /dso:preplanning.
**Why**: The f360 defect was a 1:1 coupling that a fan-in >= 2 threshold would miss; condition (b) catches it. Integration coverage is the gate that would have caught the producer/consumer mismatch end-to-end.
**Scope**:
- IN: union-graph construction from depends_on and cross_story_signals; the two-condition trigger; the integration-story requirement; the orchestrator-entry fixture reference in the integration story's Done Definition.
- OUT: the cross-story edge derivation itself (draft-3 owns it); sprint Phase E changes; the regression fixture family (draft-6).","priority":2,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["/dso:preplanning constructs a union graph from the depends_on edges and the cross_story_signals edges of the drafted story set ← Satisfies: sc-3","The detector requires an integration story when any node has fan-in >= 2 in either the depends_on graph or the cross_story_signals graph ← Satisfies: sc-3","The detector requires an integration story when any cross_story_signals edge exists, including a 1:1 coupling ← Satisfies: sc-3","The required integration story's Done Definition references an orchestrator-entry fixture exercising producer -> consumer -> artifact through /dso:brainstorm or /dso:preplanning ← Satisfies: sc-3","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including a 1:1-edge case that triggers the requirement and a zero-edge zero-fan-in case that does not ← Satisfies: sc-3"],"considerations":["[Threshold] Condition (b) fires on a single signal edge; do not regress it to >= 2, which was the original red-team-flagged miss.","[Coupling] The cross_story_signals graph is the set of edges draft-3's check (c) derives; consume that output rather than re-deriving edges."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["00dc-daf2-6b74-4c44","9c77-f8ff-7b8d-409a"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-3"},{"id":"066b-7d80-3f75-4133","title":"As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want the decomposer critic to flag undeclared-signal when a producer story shows tag-emit, title-prefix, or file-path patterns but declares zero signals, so that the zero-declaration bypass is closed.","description":"## Description
**What**: Extend the draft-3 critic with a heuristic post-pass that scans each producer story's file_impact and body for tag-emit patterns (e.g., --tags <bare-string>, ticket tag <id> <bare-string>), title-prefix patterns (quoted literal title patterns in story bodies), and file-path-convention patterns (paths under tickets-tracker, plugins/dso/docs/contracts/, etc.). When any pattern is detected on a story whose emits_signals is empty, the critic flags the story undeclared-signal and refuses to emit until the author adds a signal declaration OR adds an explicit signals_disclaimer: <one-sentence rationale> field.
**Why**: A story can touch signal-bearing surfaces while declaring zero signals, evading the structural checks entirely. This heuristic post-pass is the first line of defense against that bypass.
**Scope**:
- IN: the heuristic scan over file_impact and story body; the three pattern families; the undeclared-signal flag; refuse-to-emit behavior; the signals_disclaimer escape-hatch field.
- OUT: the three structural checks (draft-3); the inline field schema (draft-2); preplanning fan-in (draft-4).","priority":2,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["The post-pass detects a tag-emit pattern in a producer story's file_impact or body when emits_signals is empty and flags the story undeclared-signal ← Satisfies: sc-4","The post-pass detects a title-prefix pattern and a file-path-convention pattern on a zero-signal story and flags it undeclared-signal ← Satisfies: sc-4","When a story is flagged undeclared-signal the decomposer refuses to emit until the author adds a signal declaration or a signals_disclaimer field ← Satisfies: sc-4","A story carrying a signals_disclaimer field with a one-sentence rationale passes the post-pass without an undeclared-signal flag ← Satisfies: sc-4","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including one detection test per pattern family and one signals_disclaimer pass case ← Satisfies: sc-4"],"considerations":["[Heuristic-precision] Pattern families are heuristics; the signals_disclaimer escape hatch exists so a legitimate zero-signal story is not permanently blocked.","[Coupling] This post-pass extends the same critic script draft-3 introduces; build on that scaffold rather than a parallel critic."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["00dc-daf2-6b74-4c44","9c77-f8ff-7b8d-409a"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-4"},{"id":"aed6-bea1-68d3-40fa","title":"As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want a three-variant regression fixture family run through brainstorm and preplanning with a test asserting each fixture fires a distinct named gate, so that the three enforcement gates stay wired and cannot silently regress.","description":"## Description
**What**: Create the regression fixture family at plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/cross-skill-integration/ with exactly three variants, each mapped one-to-one onto a distinct named gate: tag-fork/ (producer emits copy-story, consumer detects copy:needed — the f360-3a5b shape; fires the drift gate, check (a)), contract-mismatch/ (a contract-doc-bearing variant: ships plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<canonical_name>.md whose canonical_surface mismatches the producer surface / consumer detection; fires the canonical-anchor gate, check (b)), and zero-declaration/ (producer touches tag-emit patterns but declares zero signals; fires the heuristic-undeclared-signal post-pass, sc-4). The prior surface-typo-coherence variant is repurposed into contract-mismatch because the typo variant shipped no contract doc and so could never reach check (b), leaving the canonical-anchor gate exercised by no fixture. Each variant fed through /dso:brainstorm -> /dso:preplanning independently fires exactly one of the three distinct gate identifiers. A dedicated regression test asserts the three pairings and fails on any collision or on the canonical-anchor gate going unfired.
**Why**: Without a regression family, the three gates from draft-3/draft-4/draft-5 can silently rot, and the canonical-anchor gate in particular was reachable by no fixture.
**Scope**:
- IN: exactly three fixture variants (tag-fork, contract-mismatch, zero-declaration) mapped one-to-one onto the three named gates; the contract doc shipped by the contract-mismatch variant; feeding each through brainstorm -> preplanning; the regression test asserting three distinct gate identifiers and failing on collision or on canonical-anchor going unfired.
- OUT: adding a fourth variant (the epic constrains the family to exactly three); the gates themselves (draft-3/draft-4/draft-5); the gate identifier strings (draft-3 owns them).","priority":3,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["The directory plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/cross-skill-integration/ contains exactly three variant subdirectories tag-fork, contract-mismatch, and zero-declaration ← Satisfies: sc-5","The tag-fork variant fed through /dso:brainstorm then /dso:preplanning fires the drift gate identifier ← Satisfies: sc-5","The contract-mismatch variant ships a contract doc whose canonical_surface mismatches its producer surface and consumer detection, and fed through brainstorm then preplanning it fires the canonical-anchor gate identifier ← Satisfies: sc-5","The zero-declaration variant fed through brainstorm then preplanning fires the heuristic-undeclared-signal post-pass gate identifier ← Satisfies: sc-5","The regression test asserts three distinct gate identifiers across the three fixtures and fails if any two fixtures fire the same gate or if the canonical-anchor gate is fired by none ← Satisfies: sc-5","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including the three one-to-one fixture-gate assertions and the collision-detection assertion, run green via test-batched.sh ← Satisfies: sc-5"],"considerations":["[Distinct-gates] Each fixture maps one-to-one onto exactly one named gate: tag-fork -> drift, contract-mismatch -> canonical-anchor, zero-declaration -> heuristic-undeclared-signal. The regression test fails on any collision and on the canonical-anchor gate being fired by no fixture.","[Variant-repurpose] The prior surface-typo-coherence variant is renamed and repurposed into contract-mismatch: it now ships a contract doc whose canonical_surface diverges from the producer surface and consumer detection, so check (b) is reachable. The typo variant could never reach check (b) because it shipped no contract doc (red-team / blue-team finding). The family stays at exactly three variants.","[Coupling] This story depends on draft-3 (drift and canonical-anchor gate identifiers), draft-4 (fan-in gate), and draft-5 (heuristic-undeclared-signal post-pass) existing; the gate identifier strings asserted here are the contract draft-3 emits, so this test breaks if draft-3 renames an identifier.","[Stability] Keep exactly three variants now per the epic's exactly-three constraint; the family is designed to grow in future post-mortems, not in this story."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["9c77-f8ff-7b8d-409a","5369-e1d4-4feb-4329","066b-7d80-3f75-4133"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-5"}],"storyDashboard":{"totalStories":6,"uiStories":0,"criticalPath":["ccf3-a4ad-afc8-4974","00dc-daf2-6b74-4c44","9c77-f8ff-7b8d-409a","aed6-bea1-68d3-40fa"]}}
